period_note: Balance sheet only, as at September 30, 2014 (period-end snapshot, reported), Consolidated basis (document explicitly titled 'Consolidated Balance Sheet (Un-Audited)', consolidating MTB with MTB Securities Ltd, MTB Capital Ltd and MTB Exchange (UK) Ltd). Source: MTB's own contemporaneous Q3-2014 unaudited interim financial statement, downloaded from mutualtrustbank.com's regulatory-disclosure page; pdftotext extracted 0 lines (scanned image), recovered via OCR (pdftoppm -r 200 + tesseract --psm 6). VALIDATION: all 7 asset-side line items sum EXACTLY to the document's own printed Total Property and Asset (8,565,939,715+4,223,612,511+4,800,000,000+30,522,091,234+71,786,525,697+2,475,542,552+5,529,687,180=127,903,398,889, exact match), and Total Liabilities+Equity+Minority Interest (121,535,885,755+6,367,401,255+111,879=127,903,398,889) also reproduces Total Assets exactly -- strong internal-consistency evidence for every figure used. Cross-checked against the already-stored 2013_Q4.json via this document's own Dec-31-2013 comparative column (also OCR'd): Total Assets 101,463,540,461 vs stored 101,464m (exact), gross_loans 59,548,362,590 vs stored 59,548m (exact), total_equity 5,449,063,846 vs stored 5,449m (exact) -- confirms OCR reliability. total_deposits is the ONE exception: the source document's own 'Deposit and Other Accounts' grand-total row was too visually fragmented by the OCR pass to read directly (only sub-components like Savings/Fixed/Bills-Payable were legible, and they did not cleanly foot to a total), so this field is DERIVED (basis 'calculated') as Total Liabilities minus the three other liability components (all individually clean OCR reads) rather than reported directly -- flagged distinctly from every other 'reported' field in this file. P&L is NOT extracted for the same reason as 2013_Q1 (OCR of the multi-column P&L section is unreliable for banks' dense side-by-side comparative layout; a parallel document from the same batch, 2016_Q2, was caught with a proven 6-vs-9 digit misread on Net Profit After Tax, see that file's period_note) -- no P&L line items included here rather than risk a wrong number. Minority interest (~BDT 0.11m) omitted as its own line (rounds to 0).
